listing.name: MediEvil / MediEvilRecomp (BlackLabelHQ)
listing.summary: Explore MediEvil / MediEvilRecomp (BlackLabelHQ) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Prepare the Windows player
steps.instruction: Extract the official Windows x64 ZIP into a separate folder. The reviewed v0.2b package uses the .NET 10 runtime and OpenAL; follow upstream prerequisite instructions if either is missing. Choose medievil.exe in that folder when saving launch details. Registration does not start the game.

steps.title: Choose your original disc in the game
steps.instruction: Choose Play when ready, then use MediEvil’s disc picker to select your own supported North American MediEvil CUE/BIN or CHD. The game validates the disc; Portcove does not supply original game files or run preparation tools during discovery.

steps.title: Let the game provide updates
steps.instruction: MediEvilRecomp has an in-game updater that replaces its own runtime. Keep that upstream-owned route and a separate copy of your working folder before updating. Keep settings.json, interface layout, memory-card files and custom mods with that copy, and preserve the original disc separately. Portcove leaves the external files untouched and does not provide managed Update, Backup or Rollback.
